product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Shubh Labh Door Hanging Set
product_description: Decorate your entrance with this handcrafted Shubh Labh door hanging set, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, golden detailing, mirror accents, and elegant pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Handle pearl tassels and embellishments carefully.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight and moisture.
Store flat in a dry, protective box when not in use.
